facts.fact: The preprint's authors state that the Department of National Registration, Passport and Citizenship runs a manual paper-based system for birth and death registration, and that completed Form 13 death notifications are carried weekly from local offices to provincial or national headquarters for entry into INRIS; the document gives no date for this, so its published date is used.
facts.system: Integrated National Registration and Identification System (INRIS)

facts.fact: The preprint states that data from the department's paper-based birth and death registration is then entered into INRIS, and that the department supplied death data from the registration system for 2021 to 2023; no date is given for the statement, so the published date is used.
facts.system: Integrated National Registration and Identification System (INRIS)

facts.fact: The preprint states that INRIS is deployed in select provinces, with entry made at provincial or national headquarters rather than at local offices, and gives no count of provinces or offices; no date is given, so the published date is used.
facts.system: Integrated National Registration and Identification System (INRIS)

facts.fact: The preprint states that the Department of National Registration, Passport and Citizenship, under the Ministry of Home Affairs and Internal Security, manages all civil registration and vital statistics activities; no date is given, so the published date is used.
facts.system: Integrated National Registration and Identification System (INRIS)

systems.system: Integrated National Registration and Identification System (INRIS)
systems.country_label: INRIS (also given as Integrated National Registration Information System)
systems.owner: Department of National Registration, Passport and Citizenship, Ministry of Home Affairs and Internal Security
systems.tiers: Deployed in select provinces; paper forms from local offices are entered at provincial or national headquarters; extension planned with partner support

systems.platform: KoboToolbox, hosted on Ministry of Health servers, with an online dashboard
systems.owner: Ministry of Health mortality surveillance officers, with the Department of National Registration, Passport and Citizenship and technical support from the Bloomberg Philanthropies Data for Health initiative
systems.tiers: Pilot at burial offices near mortuaries in Lusaka, Central, Copperbelt and Southern Provinces; 115,573 deaths captured from 1 July 2024 to 10 June 2025; not integrated into the main registration system
